map.PT/APTT/INR 互相换算，评估华法林抗凝达标情况: Convert PT/APTT/INR to assess warfarin anticoagulation goal.
map.= 对照PT / (对照PT + 0.6×(患者PT - 对照PT)) × 10: = Control PT / (Control PT + 0.6×(Patient PT − Control PT)) × 100%, <40% suggests severe liver damage
map.APTT比值 = 患者APTT/正常APTT，1.5-2.5为肝素治疗达标范围: APTT ratio = Patient APTT / Normal APTT; 1.5–2.5 is the heparin-treatment target range
map.房颤/瓣膜病患者抗凝随访，把不同试剂 PT 统一折算为 INR 比对目标范围（通: For AFib/valve patients on anticoagulation, unify different-reagent PT into INR against the target range (usually 2.0–3.0).
map.教学演示 ISI 对 INR 的影响。: Demonstrate ISI's effect on INR in teaching.
Patient PT 30s, Normal PT 12s, ISI 1.0: INR = (30/12)^1.0 = 2.5, within the common anticoagulation target; a different ISI changes the result, so use the same batch ISI.
map.INR 越高越好吗？: Is a higher INR always better?
map.不是。过高出血风险升高，过低血栓风险升高；目标区间由疾病与医师设定。: No. Too high raises bleeding risk, too low raises thrombosis risk; the target range is set by the disease and physician.
map.能吃影响 INR 的食物药物吗？: Can you eat foods or drugs that affect INR?
map.富含维生素 K 食物、部分抗生素与中药会影响，服药期间应规律监测并告知医师用药。: Vitamin-K-rich foods, some antibiotics and herbs affect it; monitor regularly while on therapy and tell your physician about all medications.
map.不能，仅做换算，剂量由抗凝门诊或医师调整。: No, it only converts; the dose is adjusted by the anticoagulation clinic or physician.
map.INR 换算工具。按 PT 与 ISI 计算国际标准化比值，用于抗凝监测强度换算: An INR converter. Computes the international normalized ratio from PT and ISI for anticoagulation-intensity conversion; dose is set by the physician.
